fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2023 by $182.1 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: States 'do not currently hold any derivative financial instruments'. No fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) 591,796 [2023] 527,290 [2022] 12.2% [from 2023 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 5.7% from $1,931.5 million in 2022 to $1,820.5 million in 2023 due to 12.2% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
